Actor.description: Who caused the event: a user (by ID) or a system component (by name).
Actor.title: Actor

envelope.description: What is stored in the outbox and published to NATS, byte for byte.

aggregate_version.description: Version of the aggregate after the change, if versioned.
aggregate_version.title: Aggregate Version

causation_id.description: The event that caused this one, when a consumer emits it.
causation_id.title: Causation Id

correlation_id.description: Request ID of the API call (or the causing event's).
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

event_id.description: UUIDv7; also the NATS message ID (deduplication).
event_id.title: Event Id

envelope.title: EventEnvelope

1.description: The tenant's AI switches or retention changed: screens hide or show AI features live.
1.title: AiSettingsChanged

1.description: A dashboard was deleted (soft).
1.title: DashboardDeleted

1.description:
A dashboard was created or changed (`changed_fields` empty on create).

`was_shared`: it was shared before this change, so its former viewers must hear of it
(un-sharing closes it on their screens, REQ-DSH-028 AC2).
1.title: DashboardSaved

1.description: A role's default home dashboard changed (its holders' home pages follow).
1.title: DashboardHomeChanged

1.description: A saved report was deleted (soft).
1.title: ReportDeleted

1.description: A saved report was created or changed (`changed_fields` empty on create).
1.title: ReportSaved

1.description: An export is ready or failed (`problem` says why).
1.title: ReportExportFinished

1.description: Someone asked for a report export; the worker builds it.
1.title: ReportExportRequested

1.description: A shared folder was deleted; its reports moved to `moved_to` (None: their owners' own).
1.title: ReportFolderDeleted

1.description: A shared folder was created or renamed.
1.title: ReportFolderSaved

1.description: A schedule's time came; the worker sends it.
1.title: ReportScheduleDue

1.description: A run finished: how many recipients got it, and why a failed run failed.
1.title: ReportScheduleRan

1.description: A schedule was created, changed, paused, resumed or deleted.
1.title: ReportScheduleSaved

1.description: The tenant's report settings changed (week start, limits).
1.title: ReportSettingsChanged

1.description: A new announcement was saved (always as a draft).
1.title: AnnouncementCreated

1.description: Moved to the trash (soft delete).
1.title: AnnouncementDeleted

1.description: Taken back out of the trash.
1.title: AnnouncementRestored

1.description: Published, unpublished, archived or reopened.
1.title: AnnouncementStatusChanged

1.description: Fields changed (names only); `status` is the (unchanged) status at the time.
1.title: AnnouncementUpdated

1.description: The module's tenant settings changed (e.g. the four-eyes rule).
1.title: AnnouncementSettingsChanged

1.description:
Something security admins must see: a broken chain, overdue sealing, probing.

REQ-AUD-005, REQ-AUD-010. The notification engine (WP-023) will deliver it; until then the
console shows a banner and operations get a metric alert (D-076).
1.title: AuditAlertRaised

1.description: An auditor asked to restore an archive for an investigation; the worker does it.
1.title: AuditArchiveRestoreRequested

1.description: A month was archived (`status` ready or failed) or a restore finished (`restore_status`).
1.title: AuditArchiveUpdated

1.description: Entries from `from_seq` to `to_seq` joined the chain; open audit screens refresh.
1.title: AuditEntriesSealed

1.description: An entry was written; wakes the sealer (it seals everything queued for the tenant).
1.title: AuditEntryRecorded

1.description: An export is ready or failed (`problem` names why).
1.title: AuditExportFinished

1.description: An auditor asked for an export; the worker builds it.
1.title: AuditExportRequested

1.description: The tenant's audit settings changed (field names only).
1.title: AuditSettingsChanged

1.description: A verification run finished (`status`: passed, failed or error).
1.title: AuditVerificationCompleted

1.description: Someone asked for a verification now; the worker runs it (it can take minutes).
1.title: AuditVerificationRequested

1.description:
Auto-assignment found nobody (REQ-ASG-011): the record waits in its group's queue.

The group head is told (notifications, WP-023) once per record; the record is offered again
when a member becomes available.
1.title: AssignmentWaiting

1.description: A technician set themselves (or was set) Available or Away (REQ-ASG-006 AC3: live).
1.title: AvailabilityChanged

1.description:
A business rule, routing rule, trigger or setting was added, changed, reordered or removed.

Admin screens reload the list; the engine reads definitions per save, so nothing is cached.
1.title: AutomationChanged

1.description: A loop cap was hit (REQ-RUL-028): the chain stopped; the record and owners are told.
1.title: AutomationStopped

1.description: The tenant's access defaults changed (WP-021, D-073): compiled permissions refresh.
1.title: AccessSettingsChanged

1.description: An API key was made or revoked (WP-041, D-128): key screens refetch. Never the key text.
1.title: ApiKeyChanged

1.description: A support group gained or lost a role: its members' access changes (WP-042).
1.title: GroupRoleChanged

1.description:
The tenant's sign-in settings changed (WP-039).

Sessions, people creation, invitations, the password policy, or the worker's result
applying it (`password_policy_state`).
1.title: IdentitySettingsChanged

1.description: An invitation was sent, resent, accepted or revoked (WP-039 session 2).
1.title: InvitationChanged

1.description: An MFA policy, a person's enrolment or an admin reset changed (WP-039 session 3).
1.title: MfaChanged

1.description:
An admin saved the password policy, or asked to apply it again.

The worker writes it into the realm, reading it from the settings when applied, so only the
newest policy is ever written.
1.title: PasswordPolicyChanged

1.description: A people import moved on (WP-021): counts only, for the live progress bar.
1.title: PeopleImportProgressed

1.description: A role was created, edited (name, description, permissions) or deleted (WP-016).
1.title: RoleChanged

1.description:
A signed-in user moved their session into this tenant.

Published in the tenant switched TO only; the previous tenant is deliberately not named, so
one tenant's subscribers never learn which other tenants a user belongs to.
1.title: SessionTenantSwitched

1.description: A single sign-on set-up was added, changed, tested, switched on or off, or removed.
1.title: SsoProviderChanged

1.description: An admin or an import added a person before their first sign-in (WP-021).
1.title: UserCreated

2.description:
As UserCreated, with `email` as a source: a mail sender made a requester (WP-024).

A new allowed value retypes a field, so a new schema version (docs/architecture/events.md
"Versioning"); v1 stays registered for anything that still reads it. Published from WP-024 on.
2.title: UserCreatedV2

3.description:
As UserCreatedV2, with service identities: a connector's own identity (WP-040).

`service` and `integration` are new allowed values, so a new schema version; v1 and v2 stay
registered. A service identity never signs in and is never in people lists.
3.title: UserCreatedV3

1.description: A user started a session in this tenant.
1.title: UserLoggedIn

1.description: A user ended their session in this tenant.
1.title: UserLoggedOut

1.description: A user signed in to a tenant for the first time and got a user record there.
1.title: UserProvisioned

1.description:
A person was deactivated or reactivated (WP-021); a deactivated person cannot sign in.

WP-040 (agreed with lane A, 2026-10-29) adds two defaulted fields, so the contract stays v1
and older events still read: `reason` says who made the change (an admin, the directory sync
or a privacy erasure) and `source` which directory, when it was the sync. Lane A's
"needs reassignment" view flags a leaver's open incidents from `reason = "directory"`.
1.title: UserStatusChanged

1.description:
Profile fields changed (names only, never values).

Preferences edited by the user (WP-008), the person record edited by an admin (WP-021), or
`sign_in_linked` when a person added by an admin first signs in (D-092).
1.title: UserUpdated

1.description: A role was assigned to or removed from a user (WP-016).
1.title: UserRoleChanged

1.description:
A connector turned failing: its admins are told once per failure (REQ-INT-005, WP-040).

Replaces `integrations.mailbox.failing` for mailboxes (kept, and still handled, until the
contract step).
1.title: ConnectorFailing

1.description: A failing connector works again: its admins are told once (REQ-INT-005 AC2).
1.title: ConnectorRecovered

1.description: A tenant's connector defaults were saved (WP-040, D-041): the settings card refetches.
1.title: ConnectorSettingsChanged

1.description: A directory connector was added, changed or removed, or a sync run finished (WP-040).
1.title: DirectoryChanged

1.description: A mailbox was added, changed or removed, or a fetch changed its state or its mail.
1.title: MailboxChanged

1.description: The OAuth app's secret or certificate expires within the warning period (REQ-INT-050).
1.title: MailboxCredentialExpiring

1.description: A mailbox stopped working, or fails for a new reason: its admins are told (never silent).
1.title: MailboxFailing

1.description:
A sender went over the flood limit: their mail waits in the review queue (REQ-NTF-023).

Raised once per flood (the first message held for it in the hour), so admins are told once,
not per message. No address in the payload: the review queue shows who it is.
1.title: MailboxMailHeld

1.description: An article or one of its drafts was created or changed (`language`: the draft's).
1.title: KbArticleSaved

1.description:
A step of an article's review life (D-108 (5)), for notifications and live screens.

Steps: submitted, approved, rejected, withdrawn, reviewed ("still correct"), deleted, restored.
1.title: KbArticleWorkflow

1.description: An article's link to a record was removed (D-121).
1.title: KbLinkRemoved

1.description: An article was linked to a record (REQ-KB-064): by hand, by an insert, or made from it.
1.title: KbLinkSaved

1.description: The tenant's knowledge settings changed (the settings page and the editor refetch).
1.title: KbSettingsChanged

1.description: A topic went to the trash; its articles moved to `moved_to` (REQ-KB-004 AC2).
1.title: KbTopicDeleted

1.description: A topic was created or changed (moved, renamed, its audience).
1.title: KbTopicSaved

1.description: An article type was added or changed: names, review interval, retired (D-120).
1.title: KbTypeSaved

1.description:
Someone voted on whether an article helped, or changed their vote (REQ-KB-069).

No person, answer or comment: the article page refetches the counts with its reader's rights.
1.title: KbVoteSaved

1.description:
The tenant's entitlement changed (plan, add-ons, limits, term or status).

Consumers: the entitlement cache invalidation (this module); later the realtime fan-out
(WP-011) so open consoles re-read GET /api/v1/entitlements and show or hide menus live.
1.title: EntitlementChanged

1.description: A custom field was added, changed, retired, brought back, removed or reordered.
1.title: CustomFieldChanged

1.description: A notification was sent, held back or failed for a record (the record's log, REQ-INC-134).
1.title: DeliveryRecorded

1.description: A new entry in a person's notification centre (their personal channel shows it live).
1.title: NotificationCreated

1.description: A person read entries (one, or all of them): their other devices update the badge.
1.title: NotificationsRead

1.description: A person changed their notification preferences (every device applies them at once).
1.title: PreferencesChanged

1.description: An admin changed the rule of one event (on/off, recipients, channels, conditions).
1.title: RuleChanged

1.description: The tenant's branding was saved or reset (WP-017): open screens reload the brand.
1.title: BrandingChanged

1.description: A department was created, changed, made inactive or removed (WP-021).
1.title: DepartmentChanged

1.description: A desk was created or changed (WP-021, ESM).
1.title: DeskChanged

1.description: A custom domain was added, checked, given a certificate or removed (WP-017).
1.title: DomainChanged

1.description: A user was added to or removed from a site or support group.
1.title: MembershipChanged

1.description: A site was created, changed, made inactive or removed.
1.title: SiteChanged

1.description: A support group was created, changed, made inactive or removed.
1.title: SupportGroupChanged

1.description: The tenant's instance settings changed (WP-042): defaults and languages refetch.
1.title: TenantSettingsChanged

1.description: A category was added or changed.
1.title: ServiceCategoryChanged

1.description: An item was added or changed (names only of the changed fields).
1.title: CatalogItemChanged

1.description: A working calendar went to the trash (only when no site, group or policy uses it).
1.title: SlaCalendarDeleted

1.description: A working calendar was created or changed (its week, zone, name or holiday lists).
1.title: SlaCalendarSaved

1.description: A holiday list went to the trash; the calendars that used it no longer do.
1.title: SlaHolidayListDeleted

1.description: A holiday list or its holidays changed (`holiday_ids`: the holidays added or changed).
1.title: SlaHolidayListSaved

1.description: The order of a record type's policies changed (first match wins).
1.title: SlaPoliciesReordered

1.description: A policy went to the trash (never the fallback).
1.title: SlaPolicyDeleted

1.description: A policy was created or changed (conditions, targets, enabled, name).
1.title: SlaPolicySaved

1.description: A record got its SLA policy, or another one after a change (`kinds`: targets started).
1.title: SlaApplied

1.description: A record type's SLA settings changed (warning point, priority-change or reopen rule).
1.title: SlaSettingsSaved

1.description: The target's due moment passed while it was open (REQ-SLA-020); the stamp stays.
1.title: SlaBreached

1.description:
An escalation level ran, once (REQ-SLA-022). `run_id` names the run and its level.

`notify` False: the level only acted, or the tenant-wide switch held its messages.
1.title: SlaEscalated

1.description: The target was met (on time, late, or by the resolution).
1.title: SlaMet

1.description: The record entered an on-hold status: the target's clock stopped counting.
1.title: SlaPaused

1.description: A new due moment: priority, policy, calendar or reopen.
1.title: SlaRecalculated

1.description: The record left the on-hold status: the clock counts again, with a new due moment.
1.title: SlaResumed

1.description: A person set the due date by hand, or cleared it (REQ-SLA-028; who and why on the target).
1.title: SlaSetByHand

1.description: Closed or canceled before the target was met; never a breach by itself.
1.title: SlaStopped

1.description: The target reached its warning point (REQ-SLA-019).
1.title: SlaWarning

1.description: A file's state changed (scanned, blocked, deleted, moved from a draft): screens refresh.
1.title: FileChanged

1.description: A file was stored; the scan worker picks it up.
1.title: FileUploaded

1.description: The tenant's file rules changed (admin screens refresh).
1.title: FileSettingsUpdated

1.description: A message was queued; the mail worker sends it.
1.title: MailQueued

1.description:
A send attempt ended: sent, failed for good, or to be tried again (REQ-INC-059).

The notification engine moves the delivery log and the record's message along with it.
1.title: MailStateChanged

1.description:
An approval was opened, decided, closed or withdrawn (WP-030 s2, REQ-SR-024).

`approver_id` None: the approval administrators hold it. IDs and codes only, never the
comment; the record's screens and the approver's drawer refetch through the API.
1.title: WorkItemApprovalChanged

1.description: A bulk job started, finished a batch or ended (REQ-INC-120 AC3; counts only).
1.title: WorkItemBulkJobProgressed

1.description:
A reply or note was saved (WP-020b). Notifications (WP-023) and email (WP-024) start here.

`mentioned_ids` holds only people who may see the record (REQ-INC-063 AC2); `first_response`
is true when this entry stamped the record's first response (REQ-INC-065).
1.title: WorkItemConversationAdded

1.description:
A reply's e-mail moved: waiting, queued, retrying, sent or failed (REQ-INC-059).

Raised when the notification engine learns how the e-mail to the requester went; the timeline
refetches the entry (codes only, never an address or the server's text).
1.title: WorkItemConversationDeliveryChanged

1.description: A note was made public or private (REQ-INC-061 AC3). `visibility` is the new one.
1.title: WorkItemConversationVisibilityChanged

1.description: Someone follows the record now (REQ-INC-056/151).
1.title: WorkItemFollowerAdded

1.description: Someone stopped following (themselves, or removed by someone allowed to).
1.title: WorkItemFollowerRemoved

1.description: A user's columns, sort or page size of one view changed (their other windows follow).
1.title: WorkItemListSettingsChanged

1.description:
A task, worklog or link of a record was added, changed or removed (WP-020e).

The record's screens refresh that part; IDs only, never the part's content.
1.title: WorkItemPartChanged

1.description: A reply template was added, changed or removed (open composers reload the list).
1.title: WorkItemReplyTemplatesChanged

1.description: A type's configuration changed (prefix, default priority, categories ...).
1.title: WorkItemSettingsChanged

1.description: A saved view was added, changed or removed (WP-020d; the view menus reload).
1.title: WorkItemViewChanged

Audience.description: Where a record was visible: its group, site, people and whether it was unassigned.
Audience.title: Audience

1.description: The group or technician changed (assign, reassign, take, unassign).
1.title: WorkItemAssigned

1.description: A new work item was saved.
1.title: WorkItemCreated

1.description: Moved to the trash (soft delete).
1.title: WorkItemDeleted

1.description: Taken back out of the trash.
1.title: WorkItemRestored

1.description: A status action ran (by a person, or automatically after an assignment).
1.title: WorkItemStatusChanged

Audience.description: Where a record was visible: its group, site, people and whether it was unassigned.
Audience.title: Audience

1.description: Fields changed (names only).
1.title: WorkItemUpdated
